primaryUser: people who want to execute a useful Zhihu knowledge source
canonicalThesis: Official verifiable source scope -> AI-selected program primitives -> source-bound state machine -> deterministic execution trace -> source-bound result -> optional AI result interpretation
mustPreserve: Runtime state, path, usage and deterministic Result do not call or depend on an LLM
Optional AI result interpretation is opt-in, visibly separated and cannot alter deterministic Result, source anchors or usage
Search excerpts never enter the compiler
Creator-analysis text is only read for the current Access Secret owner and retains its Zhihu URL, author identity label and full-text hash
Started requires the first valid component interaction
Completed means the schema completion rule is satisfied, not a real-world outcome
Every key action requires a validated source anchor
Bounded excerpts disclose their exact character range and never claim whole-article coverage
One canonical Run per source with versioned schemas
Human preview is required before publish
A published Run has at least two source-bound program primitives and a declared state transition for every required action
p0Exclusions: model-controlled runtime path or unbounded runtime chat
implementationGate: PRODUCT-FREEZE.md must be APPROVED by the human product owner
